# iru_in_house_app (Data Source)

Reads the supported In-House App resource configuration and optional IPA hash/size for one exact existing Library Item UUID through GET only. Observes flags without managed-resource platform defaults or write constraints. Missing/null required fields fail; missing/null optional metadata stays null. Excludes signed URLs, upload credentials, installer bytes and parsed IPA metadata. Never uploads, assigns, activates, installs or deletes anything. The single-object endpoint is not paginated.

Reads configuration and optional installer metadata for one IPA Library Item
UUID. The installer key is sensitive and remains in state. Signed URLs, binaries
and upload credentials are excluded. Reported key/hash/size does not establish
artifact availability, signing validity or device delivery.

See [configuration lookup behavior](../guides/configuration-lookups.md) for
selection, errors, nulls and sensitive state handling.

## Example Usage


```terraform
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

# Synthetic UUID: replace with an existing In-House App Library Item UUID.
data "iru_in_house_app" "selected" {
  library_item_id = "aaaaaaaa-bbbb-4ccc-8ddd-000000000095"
}

output "in_house_app_name" {
  value = data.iru_in_house_app.selected.name
}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `library_item_id` (String) Exact existing In-House App Library Item UUID. Names and partial IDs are not accepted.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Observed activation flag. Reading never activates the item.
- `file_key` (String, Sensitive) Reported IPA installer key. Sensitive in displays because it may reveal private names/paths, but stored in Terraform state. Not a download URL or installer export.
- `file_size` (Number) Reported IPA byte size, or null when missing/null. Zero remains known zero.
- `id` (String) Canonical In-House App UUID.
- `name` (String) Current Library Item display name.
- `runs_on_ipad` (Boolean) Observed iPad target flag. Missing/null is an error, not an invented false default.
- `runs_on_iphone` (Boolean) Observed iPhone target flag. Missing/null is an error, not an invented false default.
- `runs_on_tv` (Boolean) Observed Apple TV target flag. Missing/null is an error, not an invented false default.
- `sha256` (String) Reported IPA SHA256, or null when missing/null. Letter case is preserved. No installer bytes are downloaded or verified.
